title: Integral compact-support image preserves uniform constructibility

from.place: Proof, sole paragraph: the completed exchange is an isomorphism of integral constructible functors; the constructible landing is the finite-level condition

statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $I=(\varpi)$. Use the completed coefficient sheaves $A_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_T$ and $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $X,Y$ be noetherian schemes (admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) of finite Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], with $\ell$ invertible on both. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated and of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and choose a compactification
$$X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y,\qquad pj=f,$$
with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $p$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism].
For $T=X,Y$, let $\mathcal C_T=\Dbc(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ be exactly the full category of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]: its objects are derived $I$-complete, their normalized reduction towers have common bounded adic-lisse finite-type local models, and they admit compatible etale-origin witnesses. Use its inherited triangulated structure [lem-weil-pbc-uniform-complete-triangulated].
Identify $A_{\overline X}|_X=A_X$ by restriction to the open subscheme. Let $j_!$ be exact module extension by zero on this localized ringed site, applied degreewise [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], and let $Rp_*$ be the completed-coefficient derived module direct image [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Define $Rf_!^c=Rp_*j_!$, the chosen-compactification candidate [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. Then $Rf_!^c$ restricts to an exact $A$-linear functor
$$Rf_!^c:\mathcal C_X\longrightarrow\mathcal C_Y$$
[def-weil-linear-functor, def-weil-triangulated-category]. In particular the output belongs to the full compatible uniform category just specified, including its compatible etale-origin witnesses.

proof.text: Normalize the chosen completed coefficient isomorphism against the datum integralRingIso. Project to each positive quotient: the completed comparison commutes with the limit projections, and fourCornerProjectionComm supplies the same finite inverse-image map. Joint monicity of the projections identifies the maps. The generic proved scalar-section lemma in PbcScalarExtension applies after this normalization; the module direct image is A-linear sectionwise, hence its adjoint module pullback is A-linear.

proof.text: Properness makes the compactification scheme locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, hence Noetherian. The finite-type dimension-bound proof gives a natural bound on its dimension; field base change bounds every geometric fibre by the same number. The structure map pulls the inverse of l on Y back to an inverse on the compactification.

proof.text: Apply the actual-universe integralPadicLocalPerfectCriterion to K. Append the reduced closed complement of the open immersion to its finite locally closed stratification. On each old stratum retain its covering sieve and bounded finite-projective complex: pullback composition, the open-unit isomorphism and the normalized ordinary-pullback transport give the required realization isomorphism. On the new stratum, closedDerived_isZero and the faithful derived scalar equivalence give zero pullback. Choose the zero cochain complex as its bounded finite-projective model. The reverse local-perfect criterion gives membership for the concrete cbcDerivedOpenShriek. Adjoint uniqueness identifies this with the chosen derived open extension.

proof.text: The DVR maximal-ideal description and the extending norm show l lies in the uniformizer ideal. Apply the actual-coefficient constructible-preservation theorem to the identity Cartesian square for the proper part of the compactification, with N=l and the geometric-fibre bound above. Its first conclusion gives bounded constructible complete membership of the proper image. Transport through the chosen-open-extension isomorphism and the normalized coefficient equality using isomorphism closure of the uniform category.

proof.text: The exact chosen module open extension is A-linear by its adjunction to the A-linear module pullback. Module direct image is A-linear by the constant-section equation of step 1; its derived right adjoint is A-linear as well. The derived linearity and additive instances give the scalar and addition clauses for the composite. Exact degreewise open extension and derived direct image are triangulated with the already specified shift comparison, so map_distinguished gives the last clause.

The repair fixes the return: the steps are now 478–1115 characters and each extracted argument is a genuine smaller lemma, not a restated clause. Steps 1–7 check: the geometry lemma gives Noetherian finite-dimensional X̄, the geometric-fibre bound e and ℓ invertible. The DVR facts give the finite quotients A/I^n and ℓ in I. The characterization's (i)⇒(ii) on X, the model lemma, then (ii)⇒(i) on X̄ give J in C_X̄ with its witnesses. The cone of ϖ^n gives the uniform interval [u-1,v]. Preservation applied to the identity square (N=ℓ, fibre bound e) gives Rp_*J in C_Y. Linearity comes from the new extension-by-zero lemma plus lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange on complete objects, and step 7 restricts to full triangulated subcategories. The coefficient category is the completed A_T throughout; no constant-coefficient comparison and no SGA source is used. All 11 declared tool uses are accepted. No missing or merged ids, no cycles, citers unaffected. New-node checks: the geometry lemma is true and not a duplicate (lem-fin-finite-type-fibre-dimension-bound covers only ordinary fibres); the stratified-model lemma is true, since the stratification definition needs only a disjoint locally closed cover, j^{-1}j_! is the identity and i^{-1}j_! is zero; the linear extension-by-zero lemma is true, and Mathlib's derived-linearity instance assumes linearity rather than proving it, so it is not a leaf. Edge cases tested: empty schemes, U empty or U=T, K=0, A=0.
